study_identification_part.si4_title: Linking Personalized Brain Atrophy to Schizophrenia Network and Treatment Response

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Establish vertex-wise normative reference ranges for cortical thickness using healthy controls, compute patient-specific deviation (atrophy) maps in schizophrenia, derive personalized atrophy networks from healthy rs-fMRI, and test whether these networks relate to rTMS treatment outcomes.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Single-center hospital dataset (Hefei, China; University of Science and Technology of China / Anhui Medical University)
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper states data were retrospectively selected from the hospital database and acquired at a single center in Hefei, China (USTC scanner; patients enrolled at Anhui Mental Health Center).
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: "MRI data of 797 healthy subjects and 91 schizophrenia patients ... were retrospectively selected from our hospital database." ... "Structural and fMRI data were obtained at the University of Science and Technology of China (Hefei, China) ..."
